question:
Choose the one which can be substituted for the given sentence.

A word formed from the initial letters of a name
solution:
The correct answer is: **Acronym**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Acronym"** refers to a word that is formed by taking the initial letters of other words in a phrase and pronouncing them as a single term. (संक्षिप्त रूप)

 
 
• **Example:** NASA is an acronym for "National Aeronautics and Space Administration."
 
 
 
• The given sentence describes a word formed from the initial letters of a name, which perfectly matches the definition of an acronym.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Acronym**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pseudonym** (छद्म नाम): A fictitious name used by an author instead of their real name.

 
 
• **Example:** Samuel Clemens wrote under the pseudonym "Mark Twain."
 
 
 
• **Homonym** (समानार्थक शब्द): A word that is spelled and pronounced the same as another word but has a different meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** The word "bat" can refer to a flying mammal or a piece of sports equipment.
 
 
 
• **Antonym** (विलोम शब्द): A word that has the opposite meaning of another word.
 
 
• **Example:** "Hot" is an antonym of "cold."
